Making Waves with Visuals.

Who is Pino?

I’m Pino, a first-year Visual Design student at Kookmin University.

Rather than defining myself through a single field, I’m interested in many different areas of visual culture — from illustration and web design to moving images and visual marketing.

Whenever I discover an image, idea, or form of expression that catches my attention, I want to understand it by making something of my own.

For now, I’m exploring different fields and slowly discovering what I truly enjoy and what I want to become better at.

But I’m stillat thebeginning.

There is still so much I haven’t learned, tried, or created yet.

The things I’ve made so far are less like a finished direction and more like small attempts to understand what I like.

At this point, I’m just as curious about what I will discover next as I am about what I have already made.

Now

Right now, I’m learning, experimenting, and making.

At university, I’m exploring different forms of visual expression through typography, graphic design, motion, interaction, and web design.

Inside and outside of class, I keep trying different ways of making — from moving typography and posters to interactive web experiences.

I see not only finished works, but also experiments, mistakes, and unfinished attempts as part of the process that is shaping who I am.

I’m still becoming.

Among the countless fields that deal with what we see, I’m still trying to find my own path. Something I thought I loved may change, while an unexpected field may suddenly become interesting to me. Through that process, I’m slowly discovering the images, sensations, and ideas that I keep returning to.

I don’t have a definite answer yet. For now, I think it is more important to keep looking, making, and experiencing than to decide too quickly what kind of designer I should become.

How far will this wave go?
